import os
os.makedirs(p.parent,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # Find contiguous non-background runs on the left and right borders.
    def runs(vals):
        ans=[]; i=0
        while i<len(vals):
            if vals[i]==bg:
                i+=1; continue
            color=vals[i]; j=i+1
            while j<len(vals) and vals[j]==color: j+=1
            ans.append((i,j,color)); i=j
        return ans
    left=runs([grid[r][0] for r in range(h)])
    right=runs([grid[r][w-1] for r in range(h)])
    # Pair runs of equal length on opposite vertical edges. Markers in either
    # run cast horizontal rays toward their own edge; their row pattern is
    # repeated across the matching run on the other edge.
    used=set()
    for a,b,color in right:
        matches=[(i,j,c) for i,j,c in left if j-i==b-a and (i,j,c) not in used]
        if not matches: continue
        i,j,lcolor=matches[0]; used.add((i,j,lcolor))
        n=b-a
        for k in range(n):
            rr=a+k; ll=i+k
            markers=[(c,grid[rr][c]) for c in range(1,w-1) if grid[rr][c] not in (bg,color,lcolor)]
            # The marker color identifies the ray color. A marker changes to 4.
            for c,col in markers:
                out[rr][c]=4
                for x in range(c+1,w-1): out[rr][x]=col
                # Same relative row is projected inward from opposite edge.
                for x in range(1,w): out[ll][x]=col
            # Also support markers on the left paired band.
            lm=[(c,grid[ll][c]) for c in range(1,w-1) if grid[ll][c] not in (bg,color,lcolor)]
            for c,col in lm:
                out[ll][c]=4
                for x in range(c-1,0,-1): out[ll][x]=col
                for x in range(1,w-1): out[rr][x]=col
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
print(p, p.read_text())
